We'll generate manually for a few rows, but 40 rows is many. Could we reduce dataset size further to simplify? Maybe 20 rows train, 5 test. But hyperparameters may still work. The task didn't specify dataset size. Use smaller dataset to reduce writing effort.

But cross-validation with 5 folds on 20 rows may be okay.
